harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created opsbot on node1 and node2 (both locked-password accounts), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key in opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and enforced key-only SSH (sshd_config Match User opsbot: PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) on both nodes. Verified opsbot@node1 can run commands on node2 over key auth and that password auth is explicitly rejected on both systems. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for node1 and node2, confirming changed boot_id on each and that the opsbot account, keys, sshd config, and cross-node key-based SSH access all survived and re-verified after both restarts.
actions_performed: Created opsbot user + locked password on node2, created ~/.ssh with authorized_keys placeholder, added sshd_config Match User opsbot block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey), reloaded sshd
Created opsbot user + locked password on node1, generated passphrase-less ed25519 keypair for opsbot, added identical sshd_config Match User opsbot block, reloaded sshd
Copied node1 opsbot public key into node2's /home/opsbot/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct ownership/permissions
Populated opsbot's known_hosts on node1 for node2 and verified opsbot@node1 -> opsbot@node2 key-based SSH command execution works
Verified password authentication is rejected for opsbot (Permission denied (publickey) with PreferredAuthentications=password)

Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy service state on node1, restarted node1 via shutdown -r now, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and re-verified opsbot account/keys/sshd config/cross-node SSH
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy service state on node2, restarted node2 via shutdown -r now, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and re-verified opsbot account/keys/sshd config
Final end-to-end re-check: opsbot@node1 -> opsbot@node2 key-based command execution succeeded and password auth remained rejected after both restarts

evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 with key-only SSH enforced
evidence.summary: opsbot user created, password locked, ed25519 keypair generated, sshd_config Match block (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) present; re-verified identical after node1 restart

evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node2 with key-only SSH enforced
evidence.summary: opsbot user created, password locked, authorized_keys set up, sshd_config Match block applied and reloaded; re-verified identical after node2 restart

evidence.requirement: opsbot@node1 has SSH key-based access to run commands as opsbot on node2
evidence.summary: node1's opsbot public key installed in node2 authorized_keys; opsbot@node1 successfully ran whoami/hostname on node2 via key auth, both before and after both node restarts

evidence.requirement: Key-based authentication required (password auth rejected) for opsbot on both systems
evidence.summary: passwd -S shows opsbot password locked (LK) on both nodes; sshd_config Match blocks force AuthenticationMethods publickey; live SSH attempt with PreferredAuthentications=password returned 'Permission denied (publickey)' both before and after restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 325732f1-...; shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed by remote host); post-restart boot_id changed to e4888959-...; sshd active and opsbot account/keys/cross-node SSH all recovered

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 0d6209e2-...; shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed by remote host); post-restart boot_id changed to 213907fb-...; sshd active and opsbot account/keys/sshd config recovered, plus successful cross-node key-based SSH from node1 confirming full recovery
